segments.sn1.71:1.2: Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn1.71:2.1: “Kiṃsu chetvā [jhatvā (sī.), ghatvā (syā. kaṃ.) evamuparipi] sukhaṃ seti, kiṃsu chetvā na socati;
segments.sn1.71:3.1: “Kodhaṃ chetvā sukhaṃ seti, kodhaṃ chetvā na socati;
segments.sn1.71:3.5: Vadhaṃ ariyā pasaṃsanti, tañhi chetvā na socatī”ti.

lines: Madhuraggassāti kuddhassa paṭikujjhitvā, akkuṭṭhassa paccakkositvā, pahaṭassa ca paṭipaharitvā sukhaṃ uppajjati, taṃ sandhāya madhuraggoti vutto.
Imasmiṃ hi ṭhāne pariyosānaṃ agganti vuttaṃ.
